content_en: Seven years entrepreneurship acquired by unicorn he says goodbye. From three hundred thousand savings to being acqui-hired his lessons are blood and tears. He is engineer turned marketer then entrepreneur now CEO of AI business. Product is Linguix AI writing assistant for knowledge workers. Team worked on it for almost seven years. Recently he and cofounder were acqui-hired by a unicorn. At acquisition ARR was about one hundred seventy thousand dollars. Cannot share purchase price but can say using model Google used to acquire Windsurf acquired him and technical cofounder company remaining as separate active entity. Finding exit way was not easy. Finally cold outreach brought buyer. Classic scratching own itch. Before doing boutique content marketing agency working with international clients content professionals. Had to create content in multiple languages that was before ChatGPT years. Maintaining copy quality.
